note: The Mataf courtyard floor's edge (the Ottoman arcade's front columns), as [angle deg, distance m from the Kaaba's centre] in the Kaaba frame of edge/kaaba_geom.py (angle 0 = +x, the long walls' direction towards the Black Stone corner; 90 = +y, the door side). Measured 2026-10-27 on the reference frames of the two roof cameras (column bases back-projected to the floor; ~+-4 m): cam8_roof_b gives -63..35 deg, cam5_roof -114..176 deg. 35..134 deg (the north side, no roof view of it) and -114..-63 deg are interpolated, so the edge there is approximate. The far ring (edge/m2_metric.FAR) ends margin_m inside this line, so the arcade, its steps and the people inside it are left out.
